new_hypothesis.name: dexscreener_token_boosts_top_feed
new_hypothesis.mechanism: DexScreener token-boosts/top API (free, no-auth, cross-launchpad) surfaces tokens that creators or communities are paying real dollars to promote. Boost amount is a credible commitment signal -- a paid boost is a non-recoverable spend that the boosting party only makes if they expect organic demand to follow. The feed aggregates ALL Solana launchpads in a single endpoint: pump.fun, Bonk.fun (46% market share, currently INVISIBLE to the bot), BagsApp (9%, also INVISIBLE), Believe, Moonshot, Jup Studio. The bot's existing strategies are pump.fun-or-DexScreener-discovery only -- meaning ~55% of Solana memecoin attention is structurally outside the bot's coverage. Boost-paid tokens experience a 30-180 minute discovery window between the boost going live and DexScreener trending pages catching up; bots watching the boost feed directly can enter ahead of organic discovery.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Three durability layers. (1) MECHANIC: DexScreener's boost product is monetized BY them; they have direct revenue incentive to keep the feed active and free-to-read (writers pay, readers free). (2) RETAIL DELAY: most retail traders watch DexScreener trending pages, NOT the boost feed itself; the boost feed is a developer/bot-tier surface. (3) CROSS-LAUNCHPAD UNIQUE: there is no other free single-feed that aggregates Bonk + Pump + BagsApp + Believe + Moonshot launches with a uniform commitment signal. The closest substitute (paid Helius webhooks) costs money. As long as DexScreener treats boosts as their freemium hook, this edge persists.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase 1 LOG-ONLY (~50 LOC). Spawn a polling thread in degen_bot.py: every 5 minutes, GET https://api.dexscreener.com/token-boosts/top/v1 and https://api.dexscreener.com/token-boosts/latest/v1. Filter responses to chainId=='solana'. For each new mint not seen in the last 60min, atomically append to sol_dex_boosts_log.json (ring buffer 500): {ts, mint, chainId, boostAmount, totalAmount, header_image, description, url, links, dexscreener_first_seen}. Cross-link at sell-time: was the bought mint ever in the boost feed? Phase 2 (after N>=20 boosted mints with closed forward-return data): if forward 1h returns > +20% in >=50% of cases AND rug-rate < 30%, promote to a strategy 'dex_boost_snipe' that buys within 60s of seeing a NEW Solana boost IF: (a) RugCheck pass, (b) DexScreener already shows pair, (c) boostAmount >= 320 (top tier), (d) liq >= $50k, (e) age < 72h. Phase 3: tune. Caveat: boosts often follow pumps not lead them; the Phase 2 directionality test is the gate.
